in_marathi.name: Bijay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bijay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘विजय’ (Vijaya) meaning ‘victory’, ‘conquest’, ‘triumph’, or ‘victorious’. In Hindu mythology, Bijay can refer to various gods and goddesses who represent victory and success.
